This isolated patch covers Image XObject traversal through tiling Pattern resources where a resource entry reference has extra top-level operands before the next Pattern name. PdfTextExtractor now treats those Pattern entries as malformed and skips their nested Image XObject review, while preserving valid and comment-only sibling Pattern image review metadata. No Python, CUDA, OCR, model execution, multiprocessing, raster decoding, PDF action execution, decryption/password validation, pypdfium/PIL, or external PDF tools run.
